note: Written BEFORE any LAB-09 code. Every clause of the LAB-09 tasks, guide 11.1-11.4 (conclusion discipline, paired uncertainty, transition diagnostics), the acceptance requirements LAB-09 owns (T62, T63) and the phase outputs and exit gate. scripts/audit_lab09.py reads THIS file.
phase_context: LAB-08 concluded NO_PROMISING_DESIGN. That does not suspend this phase: a negative finding needs confirming exactly as a positive one does, and the exit gate asks for an honest scoped conclusion rather than an edge
clauses: the interval used for confirmation is confirmed as one no phase has consumed
if it is not a clean holdout, the nested-retrospective status is stated plainly
a prospective protocol artifact is produced, and it is NOT self-executed live
every access to the confirmation interval is logged
no retuning happens after the interval is unlocked
the unlock is recorded with a timestamp that precedes the confirmation run
the same 20 cells and cohorts as the development phase
the declared minimum seeds are used, unchanged
costs are untouched from the frozen account contract
a stateful deployment may adapt only according to the frozen policy
no human adjustment happens between the start and the end of the run
the protocol executed is the one LAB-08 froze, identified by its freeze stamp
daily PAIRED deltas between arms on the same dates
block inference that preserves time structure, not iid resampling of bars
common market shocks are preserved: symbols are resampled together, not independently
concentration is reported: how much of the result comes from how few periods
multiple comparisons follow the family protocol registered in advance
exploratory contrasts are disclosed as exploratory
block length is chosen on development and carries a sensitivity check
transaction costs are stressed at 1x, 1.5x and 2x the configured assumption
no zero-latency model refit is used as a default
no retuning happens when a stress scenario loses
a genuinely new regime episode is exercised
mixed and ambiguous states are exercised
a state-label permutation after a refit is exercised
a stale candidate bank is exercised
the case where no challenger qualifies is exercised
the case where a campaign is not flat is exercised
every fallback is checked, and the time-edge attribution is checked
fills, fees, funding, cash and PnL sum consistently
the parameter-version lifecycle reconciles: every version deployed is accounted for
every-trial cardinality reconciles against the search records
the objective recomputed from its components matches the reported value
a selected run replays to the same result
audits are retained and are not skipped by a fast profile
the net gain after risk and cost carries a confidence interval, or is called inconclusive
no 'fund-grade alpha proven' claim is made from a lab backtest
the confirmation interval was not used to adjust the design
the conclusion level comes from the registered vocabulary
diagnostics sit around DETECTED transitions, not around retrospective true starts
if the model only helps in one crash or one symbol, the conclusion is limited to that
losing periods and under-observed states are not hidden
untested heatmap cells and hindsight labels are masked or flagged, never shown as evidence
the full five-symbol paired bootstrap retains common shocks and dependence
a leakage and contamination report is written
the conclusion is honest and carries an explicit scope
a validity PASS is never presented as an edge PASS
a major causal or accounting error yields FAILED_VALIDITY and invalidates the affected runs
a failing result never keeps its headline while awaiting a retest
